answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake before entering markets. Unpredictable audits compare the behavior of linked accounts, and a detected cluster loses its stake while its reputation is erased. An attacker must therefore finance every fake identity and risk a bond for each one; creating a gale of sable and onyx accounts becomes an expensive gamble, while honest agents earn influence through useful work.
